profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer at Chewy.com
profile.summary: After many years working with server software, am now returning to my roots, in a way. Devoting all my time and energy towards iOS development, starting with an app aiding residents of my town with information and reminders for trash and recycling pickup and collections. The app makes use of some Cocoa APIs, Event kit, and other technologies.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Full member of Zipcar's iOS team, soon to ship a new, completely rebuilt app for global release. Completely written in Swift, test-driven developed, using pair programming. Unit test code coverage is at 87%; beta version 100% crash free.

positions.title: Owner & Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Creation, design and development of iPhone and iPad apps

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description: Brought over when Follett decided to go out of the software consulting business. Continuing on Scholastic products, currently as lead engineer on the server portion of System 44 NG, an early learning phonics application and enhancement to System 44. Coordinating QA as well as associated integration with other Scholastic products. Reponsible for all development aspects of the project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to completion of this release of the company's film scanner software, communicating daily with Nikon quality assurance in Japan.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Consulted to a variety of companies. Some projects include: 
* Polaroid Corporation: Completed Polaroid PolaColor Insight 5.6 for Mac OS X. 
* Lowell Observatory: Implemented a Cocoa front end to a sample serial driver. 
* Conoa: Created a VISE installer with external code and license number check to allow Conoa plug-ins to be installed to Adobe After Effects and other applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Ported Polaroid PolaColor Insight to Mac OS X. Dev tools include Metrowerks CodeWarrior, Apple's ProjectBuilder, Terminal, and PropertyListEditor. 
* Sole Mac developer for Polaroid Dust and Scratch application. 
* Developer for PolaColor Insight for Mac scanner application, versions 1.0 to 4.5. Sole Mac developer for versions 5.0 - 5.5. Responsible for architecture implementation and documentation of low-level scanner drivers, and their interface to the application. Also coordinated & assisted localization, installation, product support and quality assurance. Development experience included SCSI drivers, FireWire drivers, USB drivers, scanner technology, Apple events, Metrowerks C++ and PowerPlant, Voodoo source control, Carbon and Mac OS X. 
* Assisted in development for Polaroid DMC and DMC-2 Digital Microscopy Cameras. 
* Sole developer for Mac firmware downloading application for film recorders and scanners; Palette Export Adobe Photoshop plug-in for Polaroid film recorders.
